deadline.value: Fall: January 15 for international applicants (February 1 for Canadian residents); year inferred for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: February 1 (Canadian resident) | January 15 (U.S. and international) | Priority will be given to complete applications submitted by the deadline.

gre_subject.value: The department says the GRE is not required.
gre_subject.quote: Please note that the GRE exam is not required.

gre_general.value: The department says the GRE is not required.
gre_general.quote: Please note that the GRE exam is not required.

supervisor.value: You need not find a supervisor before applying, but no offer is made until a faculty member agrees to supervise you; strong files are circulated to faculty and may get an interview.
supervisor.quote: You are not required to find a supervisor when applying. | An admission offer will not be issued until a supervisor match has been made.

funding.value: Funding packages (awards, TA and RA positions) are offered at admission to most thesis-based PhD students; no guaranteed amount is stated.
funding.quote: Funding packages are generally available for students in thesis-based programs. | teaching and research assistantships are offered at the time of admission to most students to allow them to focus on their research and studies.

entry_route.value: An MSc in chemistry with high standing is required (biology or biochemistry for biochemistry research).
entry_route.quote: MSc degree in Chemistry with high standing from a recognized university.

notes: IELTS for Chemistry: 6.5 with no band under 6.5.
